title: A shared local notebook helps parallel agents remember dependencies and decisions
friendlyTitle: A private notebook keeps parallel AI work from getting lost
summary: Thomas Skulbru explains using a private, agent-writable work graph beside GitHub to track blocked tasks, session context and in-flight decisions across many parallel conversations. GitHub remains the public source of truth for committed work, while the local layer carries temporary operational context.
friendlySummary: A developer added a local notebook for agent sessions, blockers and decisions. GitHub still holds the official work, while the notebook holds temporary details.
whyItMatters: Teams using many agents can lose more time to coordination than they gain from parallel execution. Separating durable project commitments from private working state offers a lightweight way to preserve context without filling public issue trackers with machine chatter.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can stop people and agents from doing work in the wrong order or forgetting why a task was paused.
